programme.desc: Den tidligere regeringsagent Bryan Mills står over for sit livs længste 96 timer – jagten på den frygtindgydende organisation, der har taget hans datter.

programme.title: Fortress: Sniper's Eye
programme.desc: Den pensionerede CIA-agent Robert kaster sig ud i en vovemodig redningsaktion af sin ærkefjendes enke, Sasha. Men snart konfronteres Robert med et velkendt ansigt, som han troede, han aldrig skulle se igen...

programme.title: Taken 2
programme.desc: Den tidligere CIA agent, Bryan Mills, reddede for et år siden sin datter fra en brutal trafficking-mafia. Men intet er glemt og intet er tilgivet, for nu vil faderen til et af Bryans ofre have hævn.

programme.title: Behaving Badly
programme.desc: Rick Stevens er villig til at gøre alt for at vinde Nina Penningtons hjerte. Selv hvis det betyder at indgå et væddemål med en gangster søn.

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: En by i staten Washington vågner til det surrealistiske syn af udenlandske soldater i faldskærme, der daler ned fra himlen. Uden varsel er USA er blevet invaderet, og denne by er det første mål.

programme.title: Final Target
programme.desc: Ava er en dødsensfarlig lejesoldat, der har højprofilerede lejemord som speciale. Men en opgave går galt, og hendes arbejdsgivere sender i al hemmelighed en lejemorder efter hende...

programme.title: The Prince
programme.desc: Den pensionerede forbryderkonge og enlige far Paul, tvinges til at vende tilbage til Las Vegas og det kriminelle samfund, da hans datter kidnappes.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: Sikke en sidste uge det har været i villaen, men kærlighedssommeren 2025 er næsten forbi, og det er derfor din sidste chance for at se alt det eksklusive, aldrig før viste drama, der ikke kom med i programmet.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: Maya Jama er vært for Love Island 2025 live-finalen. Den sidste dag i villaen byder på følelser, minder og et tilbageblik på kærlighedssommeren, inden vinderne afsløres.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: 12 helt nye Islanders træder ind i Villaen og skal beslutte, hvem de skal danne par med, mens en Bombshell ankommer med en stor beslutning - og endnu større konsekvenser.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: Tonis dramatiske entré giver Shakira 24 timer til at finde en forbindelse med en ny dreng, mens pigerne føler presset for at holde på deres mænd.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: Villaen rystes af de seneste begivenheder, følelserne koger, og bånd ændrer sig. Nye deltagere bringer frisk energi, og et spil skaber drama, som alle taler om.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: Nye bånd dannes, gamle gnister blusser op, og et parskifte ryster villaen - hvilket sætter én Islanders plads i fare.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: Spændingerne stiger, når en Islander forlader villaen, og nye dynamikker tager form. Mens drengene nyder en aften ude, holder pigerne øje på afstand - og nye deltagere ryster villaen og holder alle på tæerne.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: Det er tid for drengene at stå til ansvar, når de vender tilbage til villaen med de tre nye Bombshells.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: Meg og Malisha forsøger at indgå våbenhvile, Harry, Dejon og Sheas “plan” giver bagslag, da nyhederne om deres eskapader spreder sig hurtigt, og Islanderne spiller deres første udfordring.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: Islandernes humør er stadig på kogepunktet efter udfordringen, da drengene vælger under parskiftet, og en ny Bombshell står overfor en svær beslutning.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: Islanderne venter spændt på at høre, hvilken pige den nye Bombshell Harrison tager med tilbage, mens en fest og beer pong skaber drama.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: Shakira er usikker på sin fremtid med Ben, mens Yasmin og Harry sniger sig væk til Hideaway.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: Helena har fået nok af Harry, og Toni og Yasmin snakker om drengenes opførsel. Emily forstår ikke, hvorfor Toni har noget imod hende.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: Et spil Spin the Bottle tvinger Islanderne til at afsløre ubehagelige sandheder og udføre overraskende udfordringer.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: Pigerne træffer deres valg under parskiftet, mens Helena beslutter, at hun ikke kan være venner med Harry.

programme.title: Love Island UK
programme.desc: Tommy er utilfreds med Megans nærhed til Conor. En chokerende besked ryster Islanderne, da de får en uventet opdatering fra Sleepover'en.

programme.title: On the Case: Justice Never Quits
programme.desc: Mary-Jane Marquardt, mother and wife from Chippewa, Wisconsin, was found stabbed to death in her own home. With Mary-Jane's son also missing, the detectives couldn't help but wonder if his disappearance was connected to the murder.

programme.title: On the Case: A Nightmare in Laurel
programme.desc: When a young woman disappears before her final shift at a Maryland hospital, her family begins a decades-long search for answers.

programme.title: On the Case: Snapshot to Murder
programme.desc: A high school student vanishes into thin air during a day studying in the park. Will a photograph from a nearby celebration help solve the case?

programme.title: On the Case: Hanging By A Thread
programme.desc: Hillsborough County Florida is in the midst of a horrifying crime spree. Young women are turning up dead every week. Can one teen age girl's bravery bring an end to a vicious killer's reign of terror?

programme.title: On the Case: Deadly Deception
programme.desc: Officers investigate the death of a father of four who was gunned down, however nothing about the crime is what it appears to be.

programme.title: On the Case: She Wasn't Alone
programme.desc: A beautiful young woman is viciously murdered just 24 hours after she was engaged to be married.

programme.title: On the Case: A Killer in Disguise
programme.desc: Police race to track down the unlikely killer responsible for three terrifying murders.

programme.title: On the Case: Path of Destruction
programme.desc: When a 14 year old girl is murdered detectives must solve several terrifying crimes before they can bring her killer to justice.

programme.title: On the Case: A Killer Among Friends
programme.desc: When a teenager is found savagely murdered, police must retrace her last steps alive to identify her killer.

programme.title: On the Case: At Death's Door
programme.desc: After a single mother is viciously attacked and left for dead, she still manages to help police track down her assailant.

programme.title: On the Case: A Call for Justice
programme.desc: After a man confesses to a terrible double homicide, police must determine whether he actually committed the crime.

programme.title: On the Case: The River's Edge
programme.desc: When seventeen year old high school student Stacey Fairchild disappears from a mall parking lot in Lancaster Ohio, police wonder if she ran away, was kidnapped for ransom or the victim of senseless murder.

programme.title: On the Case: The Pastor's Wife
programme.desc: Two boys witness the brutal murder of their mother, and their story may bring her cold-blooded killer to justice 30 years later.

programme.title: On the Case: Tangled Web
programme.desc: A romantic Valentine's Day rendezvous ends in murder.

programme.title: On the Case: Courage and Conviction
programme.desc: A college student's battle for survival may be the key to solving a double homicide from years earlier.

programme.title: On the Case: Almost Home
programme.desc: A young woman's battered body is found on the side of the road. The shocking evidence from the crime leads police down a trail of tragedy.

programme.title: On the Case: The Answer Was No
programme.desc: Police try to retrace a young mother's last known movements in an attempt to solve her mysterious disappearance.

programme.title: On the Case: Twisted Obsession
programme.desc: When a beautiful young woman is found murdered out in the New Mexico wilderness, police must unravel her killer's twisted obsession in order to solve the crime.

programme.title: On the Case: Where Evil Lies
programme.desc: A 25-year-old aspiring model vanishes, and the only clue police have is her empty car found near a cemetery.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: On the Move
programme.desc: A charter flight falls through the cracks after the McBryans attend a wild family wedding, and an irate Joe pulls captain Justin from the Turkey test flights to do the job.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: D-Day
programme.desc: Mikey's much-planned D-Day tribute parachute jump with 20 paratroopers hits a wall when Joe refuses to fly his DC-3 to the drop zone.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Change of Seasons
programme.desc: When her husband quits after a blowout with Joe, Kelly is put in a terrible position. Will she stay at Buffalo - or will she go? Scott gets the news he must stand down from flying so another co-pilot can fast-track to captain.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Five Seasons
programme.desc: Ice Pilots NWT celebrates a milestone with a look back at the last five years, a peek behind the camera and reflections from the Buffalo crew.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Under New Management
programme.desc: Joe hires outsider Duane Hicks to help Buffalo navigate the future and coach Mikey. Gord and Sean's DC-3 delivery mission to the High Arctic goes awry when blizzard conditions and a broken oil cooler force an emergency landing.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Over Seas
programme.desc: Buffalo has to get a CL-215 water bomber to buyers in Korea. So Justin and Cory fly the plane to Vancouver Harbour, where it will be hoisted onto a cargo ship sailing across the Pacific Ocean to its destination a method of delivery no one has ever tried.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Birthday from Hell
programme.desc: A string of bad luck turns chief pilot Arnie's 66th birthday run into the flight from hell - and threatens to spoil his naughty birthday surprise.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Power Crash
programme.desc: Cory, Chuck and Brian watch as a 5,000-pound power unit smash to the ground, denting the Electra and putting it out of commission. Mikey scrambles to manage the crisis while Joe races to England to try and purchase a backup Electra.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Frozen Four
programme.desc: As Joe fights a Transport Canada claim against the airline, star pilot Justin is tasked with shipping an 8,000lb generator to a remote town. But a controversial decision results in the DC-4 becoming stranded and frozen solid on a High Arctic airstrip.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Dark Skies
programme.desc: When Yellowknife and the northern aviation community are rocked by three crashes in the space of a month, Joe places an extra emphasis on safety, which is why he only trusts himself to perform a dangerous-looking DC-3 stunt.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Water Wings
programme.desc: In South Korea, Cory and Justin meet the ship delivering Buffalo's water bomber plane to new buyers there. But the boys are frustrated by the buyers' poor planning.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Old Dogs
programme.desc: Engine trouble plagues Buffalo's newest Electra, ZFE, and a standoff between Joe and Transport Canada threatens to close the airline. At the same time, Joe faces a tough decision about his old dog Sophie.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Under Pressure
programme.desc: The curse of -40 hits Buffalo pilots Devan and Scott on a food mail flight up the Mackenzie Valley when a mysterious rise in oil pressure threatens to destroy one of the C-46's engines.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Big Plans, Bad Luck
programme.desc: Mikey decides to get Buffalo involved in a D-Day paratrooper jump to commemorate the 70th anniversary of D-Day. Prefkar escapes Hay River courier duty. Cory finds an original bracket for the DC3 static line for Mikey's D-Day jump.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Cause for Celebration
programme.desc: AJ and Candace get married in the Ice Castle. A frustrated Chuck tries to get the Electra to pay her way. A flummoxed Mikey tries to bake a cake for Joe's birthday.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: The Right Stuff
programme.desc: Mikey goes on a treasure hunt to Venezuela for a rare CL-215 waterbomber. Cargo Manager Kelly's stress levels hit a new high when she returns from her Mexican vacation in even worse health than when she left.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Chuck Walks
programme.desc: Critical of the many stops and starts in the Electra program, and frustrated with the constant drama at Buffalo, Chuck quits. Joe clashes with the maintenance department when a series of delays puts the sale of an old Canso waterbomber in jeopardy.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Crash Landing
programme.desc: Just months from retiring, Electra captain Ray Weber leads his crew on a multi-trip mission that requires landing on a rough ice strip on a remote lake.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Checkflight
programme.desc: Joe leaves to undergo medical tests at the Mayo Clinic in Phoenix, Arizona. Jeff and Sam stress over their DC-3 checkflights and Joe celebrates turning 70-his way.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: British Invasion
programme.desc: oe and Mikey head off to Coventry, England to navigate the potential purchase of an Electra turboprop to add to Buffalo's fleet of fire-fighting tanker planes.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Chi-Town Showdown
programme.desc: Metal Victorian-era burial casket; 1870s glass fire extinguisher grenades; a mechanical 1896 handcrafted Chicago fire station alarm box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Cold Hard Cash
programme.desc: Ton and Allen go North to Alaska and get a cold reception from the local auctioneer. They find two enormous seaplane pontoons and a pair of Smith & Wesson revolvers, including the most powerful production handgun in the world!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hidden Hot Wheels
programme.desc: Ton and Allen challenge a big time auction buyer on his home turf. The guys uncover a 1969 Chevelle Malibu muscle car and a single-shot pistol designed to aid Allied resistance fighters during WWII.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Beantown Bidders
programme.desc: 1800s blackpowder whaling harpoon; 1940s Schwinn Town & Country tandem bicycle; a vintage American flag collection that could be worth thousands.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Wild West
programme.desc: Allen and Ton explain their strategies at a storage auction in San Bernardino, win two units, then have a Pepperbox gun and vintage Lionel train set appraised by experts.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Allen's Got Balls
programme.desc: After returning to LA, Ton & Allen head deep into hostile auction hunter territory and butt heads with a familiar old foe! They discover a driving range golf ball picker vehicle and one of the most accurate rifles ever made!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gangs of New York
programme.desc: Ton and Allen duke it out with a local thrift store gang at a Brooklyn storage auction. The guys discover a classic arcade redemption game and a mid-century water cannon designed to fight towering infernos!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Rodeo Ton
programme.desc: 1970s El Toro mechanical bull used to train bull riders; silver WWII era banjo; a collection of 1800s handcrafted hunting duck decoys.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Viva la Vegas
programme.desc: 1974 death-defying Zig Zag magic sword box, an ultra-rare 1910 poster of the infamous magician Chung Ling Soo, an 1800s naval cane sword and century-old Metlach German beer steins.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Top Gun Ton
programme.desc: Scale RC Viper FanJet aircraft with a potent jet engine; 1920s Gundlach Korona large format field camera used for photography expeditions. Ton pilots a plane, but crashes and burns.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Fake Punt Payoff
programme.desc: Ton and Allen contend with a large crowd of inexperienced auction-buyers at a huge storage container auction in Pasadena. They find a small fleet of Segway personal transporters and an enormous custom-made shotgun.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Knuckle Dust
programme.desc: 1870s French Jarre Dolne Knuckle Duster revolver-knife-brass knuckle combo, a rare original George Rodrigue "Blue Dog" screenprint and a 1980 autographed Raging Bull movie poster.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hula Moola
programme.desc: Ton and Allen jet to the Hawaiian islands where they're joined by a feisty new female assistant! The team uncovers a pair of James Bond-style gadgets designed for high-speed underwater travel and a vintage sled.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sidecar Surprise
programme.desc: An unassuming mom in an oversized sweater tries to pull the wool over Ton & Allen's eyes at a storage auction in Arlington, VA. The guys uncover a black powder cannon designed in the 15th century & a Russian military motorcycle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: High Flying Ton
programme.desc: A nerdy auction buyer tests Ton and Allen's patience at a big container auction in Ventura. The guys discover a basket and burners for a hot air balloon and a 19th century German single shot rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Everything's Bigger in Texas
programme.desc: Winchester 1886 rifle invented to kill buffalo; collection of 1950s electric Slot Cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Drumming Up Cash
programme.desc: Ton & Allen face some silent but deadly competition at an auction in nearby Glendale. They discover a Zildjian brand percussion cymbal from the 1940's and a pyrotechnics control board designed for large-scale fireworks displays!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Hot Commodity
programme.desc: Allen is late to the auction, leaving Ton to battle a feisty female auction buyer on his own! The guys find a fully functional flamethrower and a rare hand-carved bow and arrow set from South America!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Hot Wheels
programme.desc: '70s sand rail dune racer with rally hemi heads; 1965 replica Mustang pool table; off-road racing gear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ice, Ice, Baby
programme.desc: Ton and Allen have to get aggressive when they encounter a towering opponent with a mountain of cash. The guys uncover a vintage ice resurfacing machine and an Olympic biathlon rifle!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Labor of Love
programme.desc: Harley Davidson V-twin EVO engine and revolutionary 1958 dual-suspension swingarm frame; '80s Ms. Pac-Man arcade machine; rare Air Jordan vintage shoe collection in mint condition.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Ton's Got a Gun
programme.desc: In the affluent area of Mission Hills, CA, Allen and Ton pick up an estate unit that contains a minibike, a Depression-era slot machine and an 1871 Colt revolver.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Smoking Ton
programme.desc: WW2 Stuart M3 tank barrel and heavy duty tank treads; rare, collectors' 1890 silver inlayed humidor; high-end industrial meat slicer in the ultimate restaurant unit.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Sink or Swim
programme.desc: 1905 Hand-crank Thomas Edison gramophone with cylindrical records; a discontinued Addictor 190 Mini Boat; a rare 1897 Regina music box.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Jersey Score
programme.desc: Ton & Allen attend a silent auction in NJ, but that doesn't stop the local buyers from letting them know they're not welcome! They uncover a skeet throwing machine from the 1960's & a vintage vehicle with some real horsepower!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Big Score
programme.desc: At a climate-controlled storage facility in downtown L.A., Allen and Ton's locker wins score them an antique cash register and a German H&K pistol prized by collectors.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Battle Bought
programme.desc: Mint 1800s French "Harmonica Pistol" and a collection of '90s remote controlled combat robots.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Auction Hunters, Ink.
programme.desc: Autographed 1960s Bob Shaw Swing Gate tattoo machine; Terry Ives competition 22hp chainsaw; six foot chainsaw-carved cedar bear.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: The Dallas Mavericks

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Choo-Choo, Cha-Ching!
programme.desc: Ton and Allen get a surprise second chance after nearly getting shut out in the small town of Palmer. They uncover a motorized railroad maintenance car from the 1960's and a pre-WWI Japanese semi-automatic pistol.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Shuffle
programme.desc: Ton and Allen teach a cocky new auction hunter a lesson. They spot a 1940's-era shuffleboard table and uncover an early hot rod made from the fuel tank of a WWII fighter plane!

programme.desc: Barely making it to an auction in Corona, CA, Allen and Ton buy an overstuffed unit and find an antique crossbow, a rare 10-gauge Winchester shotgun and a 1940s Kiss-o-Meter.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Gold 'n' Gloves
programme.desc: The Auction Hunters team goes toe-to-toe with Ton's evil twin! They find a medieval catapult designed for storming castles and Ton uncovers a hidden collection of gold bars worth thousands of dollars!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Little-Ton Jones
programme.desc: Allen & Ton try to get the inside scoop on their competition by chatting up local auction buyers. The guys find some heavy gold-mining machinery from the 1950s & an amateur rocket that can travel faster than the speed of sound!

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Great American Cashtime
programme.desc: Rare 1950s Master Pitch baseball machine; 1980s Jaws of Life tool used by rescuers to pry open cars.

programme.title: Auction Hunters: Night of the Digging Dead

programme.title: The Christmas Spirit

programme.title: A Christmas Blessing
programme.desc: Mandy sælger sin afdøde tantes hjælpeorganisation til den tilstødende virksomhedsejer Adam. Men Otto, som har været frivillig på stedet, vil gerne afholde en sidste velgørende julemiddag.

programme.title: A Christmas... Present

programme.title: Meet Me Under the Mistletoe

programme.title: A Dash of Christmas
programme.desc: Megan har fundet sit drømmejob i en madvirksomhed, men først må hun lære at bage. Da hun rekrutterer en flot bager til at hjælpe sig, ender hun uforvarende med at deltage i en julebagekonkurrence.

programme.title: Hotel for the Holidays

programme.title: A Wish for Christmas

programme.title: Christmas Party Crashers
programme.desc: Da to svindlere mødes efter at have crashet den samme millionærs julefrokost, bliver de enige om at samarbejde – uvidende om, at de snart finder noget, der er vigtigere end rigdom og berømmelse: ægte kærlighed.

programme.title: The Jingle Bell Jubilee
programme.desc: En kommunaldirektør får hjælp af sin barndomsven til at arrangere byens julevelgørenhedsarrangement, og samtidigt forsøger hun at splejse ham sammen med sin nære veninde.

programme.title: Christmas Unfiltered
programme.desc: Beckys juleønske er, at hendes familie for én gangs skyld vil høre på hende. Men så begynder alle hendes tanker og frustrationer at vælte ud, da hun ufrivilligt begynder at fortælle alle, hvad hun virkelig tænker.

programme.title: NCIS: Tankespil

programme.title: NCIS: Sølvkrig

programme.title: NCIS: Skift
programme.desc: Da en underofficer brutalt bliver skudt på en motorvej, opdager Gibbs og teamet, at officeren levede et dobbeltliv.

programme.title: NCIS: Voyeurens spind
programme.desc: Gibbs og teamet efterforsker mordet på en marinesoldats kone, som åbenbart er blevet sendt ud på internettet.

programme.title: NCIS: Æreskodeks
programme.desc: Gibbs og teamet efterforsker en sag om en 6-årigs fars kidnapning.

programme.desc: Da et stykke af en kvindekrop bliver fundet ved Quantico, efterforsker NCIS-teamet sagen og bliver chokeret over at opdage, at alle de tekniske beviser peger på Tony som den hovedmistænkte.

programme.title: NCIS: Grønskolling
programme.desc: Da McGee dræber en mand under en opgave, giver NCIS-teamet sin støtte, da de opdager, at manden var undercoverbetjent.

programme.desc: Gibbs og teamet efterforsker mordet på en supermodel, der filmede et realityshow på en flådebase.

programme.desc: Gibbs og teamet bliver bedt om at efterforske en sag, da en gruppe teenagere på en vandretur finder marinesoldaters hundetegn i en nationalskov.

programme.title: NCIS: Lokkedue
programme.desc: Gibbs og teamet bliver kaldt ind, da en elev fra Quanticos high school tager en bombevest på og holder sine medstuderende som gidsler.

programme.desc: Gibbs og teamet bliver kaldt ind, da to børn finder en savnet marinesoldat i en tilfrosset sø. Da teamet efterforsker stedet for spor, finder de flere gennemhullede lig.

programme.desc: The Bundy's take on all the psychic families of the region when Al takes over Jefferson's psychic prediction scam

programme.title: Vore værste år: Hi, I.Q.
programme.desc: The Bundys are dumbfounded when Kelly is asked to join a group of geniuses.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Teachers Pets
programme.desc: Bud's teacher teaches him a lesson about the birds and the bees.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Goodbye Girl
programme.desc: Bud tries to ruin Kelly's new job at the TV World theme park.

programme.title: Vore værste år: The Gas Station Show
programme.desc: Al finds himself with the gas station blues when he can't pay his bill and is forced to work at one.

programme.title: Vore værste år: England Show I
programme.desc: The Bundy's win a trip to England -- with a deadly catch.

programme.title: Vore værste år: England Show II
programme.desc: The Bundy's arrive in Lower Uncton, England, where the townspeople are plotting to kill them.

programme.title: Vore værste år: England Show III
programme.desc: Al fights in an old fashioned joust to save his family.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Magnificent Seven
programme.desc: When Peg's 5-year-old nephew Seven is abandoned at the Bundy doorstep by his loser parents, Peg and Al decide to keep him, much to their kids' dismay.

programme.title: Vore værste år: T R A Something, Something Spells Tramp
programme.desc: When Kelly's date gives her an ultimatum, she finds herself stranded but not alone on a deserted road 15 miles outside Chicago. Meanwhile, Peg tries to put some spice back into her marriage by spending Saturday night "communicating" with Al.
programme.sub-title: T R A Something, Something Spells Tramp

programme.title: Vore værste år: Every Bundy Has A Birthday
programme.desc: When Seven can't remember his birthday, Peggy assigns him one, selecting the next day, which also happens to be Al's birthday. The family decides to go to the town park to celebrate, only to find it's been rented by a rich, snobby family.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Al On The Rocks
programme.desc: When Peggy panics over Seven's sneezes, she begins piling up medical bills, forcing Al to take on a second job as a "topless" bartender.

programme.title: Vore værste år: What I Did For Love
programme.desc: Peg tries everything in the book to renew Al's romantic interest in her -- up to and including promises of five-course meals.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Frat Chance
programme.desc: Desperate for a date, Bud founds his own community college fraternity in his garage.

programme.title: Vore værste år: The Chicago Wine Party
programme.desc: With the elections coming up, Al convinces his family to register and vote for the first time in an effort to stop a proposed tax on beer. When the tax increase passes, Al leads an angry protest to overturn the bill.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Kelly Doesn't Live Here Anymore
programme.desc: When Al can't afford to pay the bills, he convinces Kelly to get a job. Finding employment as a waitress at a burger joint, Kelly realizes why mother Peg has never worked a day in her life.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Rock Of Ages
programme.desc: Al meets rock heroes John Sebastian, Peter Noone, Mark Lindsay, Robby Krieger, Richie Havens and Spencer Davis. Mistaking him for a fellow rocker, the musicians convince Al to perform with them at a benefit.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Death Of A Shoe Salesman
programme.desc: While shopping for a burial plot for the family, Al and Peg discover they don't have enough money, so they have to be buried in the same casket.

programme.title: Vore værste år: The Old College Try
programme.desc: Bud's big plans to move into his college dorm are destroyed when Al and Peg manage to get their hands on his scholarship money and go on a shopping spree. Broke and dormless, Bud is forced back into the Bundy household.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Christmas
programme.desc: Al does his yearly pre-Christmas inspection of the family and can find they've done nothing wrong, which means he has to buy them presents, but he has to take a job as a Department Store Santa to pay for the gifts.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Wedding Show
programme.desc: As the Bundys prepare to attend their cousin Jimmy's wedding, everything begins to go wrong. Al can't find his suit, Peg can't get her make-up right, Kelly and the bridesmaids think they have on the wrong dresses and Bud gets caught with the bride.

programme.title: Vore værste år: It Doesn't Get Any Better Than This

programme.sub-title: It Doesn't Get Any Better Than This

programme.title: Vore værste år: Heels On Wheels
programme.desc: Kelly buys a motorcycle to put some fun back into her life, but disaster strikes when Al decides to take the bike out for a spin.

programme.title: Vore værste år: Mr. Empty Pants
programme.desc: Peggy's unflattering cartoon makes Al a reluctant celebrity.

programme.title: Vore værste år: You Can't Miss
programme.desc: Bud goes on a dating game for "nerds."

programme.title: Vore værste år: Peggy And The Pirates
programme.desc: While reading a romance novel, Peg fantasizes that she is a lady in distress and Al is the pirate who saves her

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: Joel and Molly fall in and out of love in this hilarious spoof on a romantic comedy from the director of WET HOT AMERICAN SUMMER and ROLE MODELS.

programme.title: 10 Things we should do before we break up
programme.desc: Den aften, hvor Abigail, en enlig mor til to små børn, møder Ben på en bar, finder de for sjov på en liste over ting, de skal gøre, inden deres tænkte brud med hinanden, selv om de ved, at de aldrig vil indlede et forhold.

programme.title: Frankie & Johnny
programme.desc: Pfeiffer spiller Frankie, der arbejder som servitrice på en kaffebar i New York. Efter flere smertelige forhold er det sidste Frankie søger en ny mand...indtil han opsøger hende.

programme.title: Café Society
programme.desc: New York i 1930’erne. Bobby har brug for luftforandring og er desperat for at komme væk fra sine emsige forældre, sin gangsterbror og familiens juvelerforretning. Bobby beslutter sig for at prøve lykken i Hollywood.

programme.title: My One And Only
programme.desc: En hårdtarbejdende mor tager sine børn med på et udfordrende road trip efter hendes mands svigt.

programme.title: Tell It to the Bees
programme.desc: Jean Markham vender tilbage til den by, hun engang forlod som teenager, nu for at overtage sin fars lægekontor. Ved et tilfælde møder hun Lydia, og der opstår følelser, som ikke burde eksistere. Farlig kærlighed i en lille by i 50'erne i Skotland.

programme.title: Broken English
programme.desc: Nora Wilder er ved at miste håbet. Alle i hendes nærhed er i et forhold, er gifte eller har børn. Nora er i 30-årsalderen, alene med et arbejde hun ikke trives med, og en mor der konstant babler løs.

programme.title: Magic in the Moonlight
programme.desc: Stanley Crawford (Colin Firth) er tryllekunstner, men skeptisk overfor det overnaturlige. Han møder den clairvoyante Sophie Baker (Emma Stone) og skal afsløre hendes tricks, men kan ikke finde nogen. Er der mon mere mellem himmel og jord?

programme.title: Love on Repeat
programme.desc: Amber er nyligt adskilt og mindre af alt. Fast besluttet på, at det er nok, beslutter hun sig for at finde noget, der kan gøre hende glad igen.

programme.title: Up In The Air
programme.desc: Ryan Bingham lever et højtsvævende liv. Han flyver over hele verden på forretningsrejser og er stadig på farten. Men så møder han medpassageren Alex og lærer, at livet ikke handler om rejsen, men om kontakterne man får på vejen.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Young Man's Fancy
programme.desc: When a newlywed couple briefly returns to the groom's childhood home, the ties of the past prove too strong to resist.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: I Sing the Body Electric
programme.desc: A widower buys a robot grandmother for his three children.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: In Praise Of Pip
programme.desc: An alcoholic bookie regrets that he wasn't a better father to his son, Pip, critically wounded in South Vietnam. A visit to an amusement park gives them both a second chance.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Steel
programme.desc: Boxing robot "Battling Maxo" breaks down before the scheduled bout, forcing his manager to take its place.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Nightmare at 20,000 Feet
programme.desc: Mr. Wilson believes he sees a gremlin on the wing of the commercial aircraft he is taking back home... from the sanitarium, where he has been committed for six months after a mental breakdown during a similar flight.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Kind of a Stopwatch
programme.desc: Patrick Thomas McNulty, a long-winded and self-absorbed know-it-all, is given a fantastic device which brings literal meaning to the expression "stop the world; I want to get off."

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Last Night of a Jockey
programme.desc: A dejected jockey wants to be tall.
programme.sub-title: The Last Night of a Jockey

programme.title: The Wraith
programme.desc: Jake bliver dræbt af kvarterets bøller og vender tilbage som en mystisk figur (The Wraith) for at få hævn.

programme.title: White Dog
programme.desc: En ung skuespillerinde finder en hvid hund, uvidende om, at den er blevet trænet til at angribe sorte mennesker.

programme.title: Cube
programme.desc: Syv vildt fremmede med vidt forskellige personlighedskarakteristika placeres ufrivilligt i en uendelig labyrint med dødbringende fælder.

programme.title: Cube Zero
programme.desc: Otte fremmede vågner op i et mærkeligt terningformet rum uden nogen erindring om, hvordan de er endt der.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: A Saucer of Loneliness
programme.desc: A quiet waitress sees a glowing UFO, which gives her a message that everyone wants to know. She refuses to reveal exactly what the message is.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: What Are Friends For?
programme.desc: A friendless boy finds the perfect playmate in the woods behind his house.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Aqua Vita
programme.desc: Aging women become addicted to Aqua Vita, which will keep them young forever, but at great cost.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: The Storyteller
programme.desc: In the early 20th century a young woman takes a job as a teacher in a one-room schoolhouse. One of her students, Mica, secretly takes extra books home to read.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: The Card
programme.desc: A compulsive spender accepts "The Card" to keep up her habit. Unfortunately stringent penalties kick in for late payments.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: Shelter Skelter
programme.desc: A survivalist traps himself in his bomb shelter when a nuclear blast finally comes.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: The Junction
programme.desc: A modern-day miner has an argument with his wife and then goes off to work in the local mine. A collapse traps him, but he finds another survivor - a miner who claims to be from 1912.

programme.title: New Twilight Zone: The Hunters
programme.desc: A young boy falls into an undiscovered cave near a housing project. An archeologist studies strange paintings on its walls and then bizarre things begin to happen. Cave items move around and animals are killed and brought into the cave.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Old Man in the Cave
programme.desc: A mysterious guardian helps a tiny community survive after the Bomb destroys much of the Earth.
programme.sub-title: The Old Man in the Cave

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Uncle Simon
programme.desc: Barbara accidentally causes her cruel Uncle Simon's death. His will stipulates that she must care for his latest invention - a robot. The robot begins to take on Uncle Simon's traits.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Probe 7, Over and Out
programme.desc: The lone survivors of two annihilated worlds are stranded on a distant planet.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms
programme.desc: Three National Guardsmen explore the site of Custer's Last Stand and encounter mysterious phenomenon that hint at the original battle occurring just out of sight.
programme.sub-title: The 7th is Made Up of Phantoms

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: A Short Drink from a Certain Fountain

programme.sub-title: A Short Drink from a Certain Fountain

programme.title: Everybody Hates Chris: Alle hader gangvagter

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Efter blot få dage på stranden skal det tabende hold i Dysten beslutte, hvem der bliver den første til at forlade Robinson Ekspeditionen 2026.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Overleverne skal endnu engang træffe svære fravalg, når en fra hvert hold sendes til Forhandling. Forhandlingen får store konsekvenser for to af Ekspeditionens deltagere.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: I ni dage har overleverne kun levet af den sparsomme kost, de selv har kunnet fange i den vilde natur. Derfor er motivationen stor i Striden, når den første madpræmie er på spil.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: I Striden kæmper holdene om en lækker frugtkurv. Men sejrens sødme overskygges af dramatiske hændelser, der får stor betydning for flere af ekspeditionens overlevere.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Med blot 4 overlevere tilbage på Hold Syd, ryster Jakob Kjeldbjerg posen, når de to hold kæmper om en hemmelighedsfuld kiste. Kisten får store konsekvenser for både Nord- og Sydboerne.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: En kammerat fra hver strand får det store ansvar, når de skal kæmpe i Dysten med hele holdets pres hvilende på deres skuldre. Taberen sender både sig selv og sit eget hold i Ørådet.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Ekspeditionen er slut for flere af deltagerne – men efterspillet er kun lige begyndt. I Robinson EXIT følger vi deltagerne tæt, når de vender tilbage til virkeligheden.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: En ny epoke i Ekspeditionen nærmer sig, og hold syd kæmper for at opnå en sejr, inden holdene opløses.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Det er tid til sammenlægning, men først skal deltagerne igennem et skæbnesvangert Øråd, hvor intet er som det plejer. Bølgerne går højt, når endnu en deltager må forlade ekspeditionen.

programme.title: Robinson Ekspeditionen
programme.desc: Pete og Alexandra er havnet i midten af to alliancer, og de står overfor en stor beslutning. Der skal bekendes kulør, og endnu en overlever får slukket deres drøm.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 402
programme.desc: Boligkøb i blindes eksperter kommer på arbejde i Hørning, hvor præsten og hendes familie bor til leje i et rækkehus og gerne vil videre – men bliver skræmte af tilstandsrapporter og spidse tage.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 404
programme.desc: Ida og Rasmus drømmer om at skifte deres 60 kvm lejebolig på Nørrebro ud med en murermestervilla i Hillerød. Men de fortryder bittert, at de lod eksperterne hjælpe, da de ser det hus, pengene rakte til.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 405
programme.desc: Anna Thora og Jonas har to små børn – og en drøm om at flytte sammen med bedsteforældrene. Så eksperterne skal på jagt efter et hus, der kan rumme to familier, med plads til alle og deres behov.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 406
programme.desc: Anne Sofie og Paw har ikke plads nok i den lille Frederiksberg-lejlighed efter familieforøgning. Men kravene til drømmehuset er tårnhøje, så selv med 7 millioner til køb, kan de ikke finde det rigtige.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 501
programme.desc: Louise og Jonas fra Viborg drømmer stort, men drømmen falder til jorden med et brag. Eksperterne kommer på ekstraarbejde, før det – forhåbentlig – ender med, at den lille familie flytter ind i drømmehuset.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 502
programme.desc: Anita og Martins to børn har overtaget hjemmet, og der er legetøj overalt. Løsningen er en større bolig, men det er ikke lykkedes parret at finde det rigtige hus. Nu går eksperterne i gang, men det bliver ikke nemt.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 503
programme.desc: Tina og Danni solgte deres rækkehus i troen på, at de nok hurtigt ville finde det rette hus. Men nej. Parret er superkræsne, og har høje krav. Kan eksperterne skabe det hjem, Tina og Danni drømmer om?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 504
programme.desc: Laura og Jesper og Jespers to børn bor til leje i Humlebæk, og det er de mildest talt trætte af. De mangler plads, have – og de vil også gerne have børn sammen snart. Men to års boligjagt har ikke givet bonus.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 505
programme.desc: Ulla og Kristian bor i en smuk herskabslejlighed på Frederiksberg med deres to børn. Men de ønsker sig mere plads i et børnevenligt kvarter i cykelafstand til indre by. Kan Tobias Edlev-Nielsen finde et hus til dem?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 506
programme.desc: En lille lejebolig i Vanløse og to små børn – det er ikke det bedste match. Lisa og Erling drømmer om et stort hus med stor have. Tobias kommer på hårdt arbejde, for drømmene er en hel del større end budgettet.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 601
programme.desc: Nathja, Kristian og deres nyfødte datter bor i en ombygget butik med en faldstamme i soveværelset. Kristian drømmer om en kæmpe garage, og Nathja vil helst blive i Køge – kan Tobias opfylde deres drømme?

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 602
programme.desc: Maja og Kenneth bor i Vestjylland og drømmer om at komme tættere på Majas familie i Silkeborg. Men deres budget kræver, at de går på kompromis med beliggenheden og kigger i de nærliggende småbyer.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 603
programme.desc: I Ikast hungrer Camilla og Marc efter et hus med plads til opbevaring. Men da Tobias finder dem et stort hus, tager det helt modet fra parret, at der nu er SÅ mange rum, der skal istandsættes...

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 604
programme.desc: Stine og Daniel sukker efter mere plads, inden de snart udvider familien fra tre til fire. Derfor er det ikke optimalt, da Mads ringer og fortæller dem, at handlen med deres nye hus i Langå er faldet.

programme.title: Boligkøb i blinde: Episode 605
programme.desc: Stine og Daniel sukker efter mere plads, inden de snart udvider familien fra tre til fire. Derfor er det ikke optimalt, da Mads ringer og fortæller dem, at handlen med deres nye hus i Langå er faldet.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Situated on the west coast of Sweden, Bohuslän is a place where you can really feel the history of fishing all around a tradition that is still active. Tareq will be harvesting supreme quality oysters and lobsters and cook some wonderful seafood dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Florø
programme.desc: Tareq visits Norway and Florø to celebrate their national day -17th of May. Surrounded by breathtaking archipelagos and stunning fjords he dives for scallops in the north sea, cooking at mountain peaks and exploring the history of norwegian salmon

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia
programme.desc: Tareq makes his way across the baltic sea to Estonia and the capital Tallinn. He discovers the historical treasures of the city and its thriving culinary life before he heads out into the vast and beautiful countryside and the national park of Soomaa.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Ringkøbing
programme.desc: Ringkøbing, a lovely old market town located at the west coast of Denmark. Here, Tareq visit a traditional Herring Festival and meets up with local entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever-changing environment.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Falkenberg
programme.desc: Something is definitely happening in Falkenberg on the west coast of Sweden. Over the last couple of years it have become somewhat of a haven for foodies. Tareq is on a mission; taking him through a fertile landscape with vineyards and salmon fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Estonia (Part 2)
programme.desc: Estonia has embarked on a journey greatly inspired by the nordic cuisine. Tareq explores the countryside of Estonia before he returns to the capital of Tallinn where he meets people that really love their traditional food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia
programme.desc: In the northern part of Sweden, you’ll find the stunning world heritage Laponia. Almost 10.000 square kilometres of nature reserves and national parks. Tareq visit the rich, unique culture of the sami in the vast impressive wilderness.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö & Copenhagen
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor returns to his home turf to see what has happened and what the future might bring to the new nordic cuisine. He visits a local goat farmer and meets up with young enthusiastic chefs who takes this nordic legacy further.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Zealand
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor visits the South Coast of Denmark to make his own versions of open-faced sandwiches and smoked fish dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Dalsland
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor puts on his hiking boots and explores the pilgrim trail of Dalsland in West Sweden. This episode will include outdoor cooking, foraging and beaver safari.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Stockholm
programme.desc: When Tareq arrives in Stockholm he will meet innovation and world class gastronomy, a big city for foodies. He will make some pizza at the Rosendal garden café and go on an adventure in the archipielago.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lolland
programme.desc: When Michelin star chefs move from Copenhagen to the countryside, they often end up in Lolland/Falster. Here Tareq will meet Claus Meyer the father of new nordic cuisine and other entrepreneurs that opened interesting restaurants here.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Skåne
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor explores his own backyard of Skåne and hometown of Malmö, a multi cultural food mix. Here you can find food and culture from all over the world that makes it a unique culinary destination.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Best Of
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor looks back on some of the food adventures he has been part of in the program series Nordic Cookery. Tareq promises delicacies from all over the Nordics and meetings with fantastic people along the way.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Läckö & Kinnekulle
programme.desc: By Lake Vänern you find Läckö and Kinnekulle, an area rich in history, culture and traditions. Tareq cooks exciting dishes on vendice roe, fish and local cheeses - all served on porcelain from the world-famous Rörstrand.

programme.title: COPS: Lady Bit My Finger
programme.desc: Missouri police recover a stolen vehicle, a scuffle between two women at a bar escalates to biting, and a concerned neighbor places a possible domestic violence call.

programme.title: COPS: Familiar Faces
programme.desc: A young carjacking suspect in custody gets a tongue-lashing from his mom and aunt, a man terrorizing his mom gets tased, and police give chase to a familiar vehicle.

programme.title: COPS: Facebook Fury
programme.desc: A DUI suspect is incensed about being detained, a woman calls police regarding a naked man on her porch, and an eight-year-old girl deprived of social media throws a tantrum.

programme.title: COPS: Without a Paddle
programme.desc: Police track a vehicle leaving a known drug house, officers sort out the facts of a domestic disturbance call, and a daughter trashes her parents' house and threatens police.

programme.title: COPS: Strange Encounters
programme.desc: Police try to settle a dispute between roommates, a jilted man causes a disturbance at a public park twice in one day, and an erratic driver proves to be surprisingly sober.

programme.title: COPS: Sucker Punch
programme.desc: Tinted car windows draw suspicion from a roaming patrol, a concerned friend gets a punch in the nose, and a traffic stop leads police a meth pipe in an odd place.

programme.title: COPS: On Thin Ice
programme.desc: A motorcyclist wanted by police hides out in his mom's garage, a man won't leave his ex-fiancee alone, and a pregnant woman gets busted for meth possession.

programme.title: COPS: Turbo Charged
programme.desc: An officer on street patrol chases down a suspect on foot, an alleged car thief posts his exploits on Facebook, and a crashed stolen car may not have been stolen after all.

programme.title: COPS: Pass the Rock
programme.desc: A police pursuit of a truck leaving a known drug location ends in a crash, undercover officers move in for a drug bust, and a man recklessly fires his handgun in the street.

programme.title: COPS: Not My Crack
programme.desc: An officer pursues an unruly bicyclist, a man ducks into a drive-through in an attempt to elude police, and a deputy pulls over a stolen vehicle driven by a repeat offender.

programme.title: COPS: Scary Monsters
programme.desc: A resistant suspect thinks he sees monsters everywhere. Cops are forced to officiate a spousal wrestling match. Officers try to sort out where two motorists got their car and whose dope they possess.

programme.title: COPS: Eye in the Sky
programme.desc: A wild-eyed man leads police on a chase that ends in a Tasing, officers respond to an in-progress lovers' spat, and a traffic stop results in drug and auto theft charges.

programme.title: COPS: Drunk in Love
programme.desc: A driver takes his unsuspecting passenger on a wild ride as he tries to evade police, a man's date is cut short by a traffic stop, and police are called to evict a roommate.

programme.title: COPS: Tell It To My Wife
programme.desc: A man arrested on warrants just wants his wife, a vagrant is caught on camera stealing from a liquor store, and officers check on a woman asleep on the side of the road.

programme.title: COPS: Crash Landing
programme.desc: Police have a breakthrough in a burglary case, a man found with drugs in his pants claims the pants are not his, and officers deal with a familiar domestic disturbance call.

programme.title: COPS: The One Dollar Shoe
programme.desc: Officers wrestle with a familiar nuisance to shop owners, a man's lucky dollar lets him down during a traffic stop, and too much whiskey leads to a domestic disturbance call.

programme.title: COPS: Getting Funcky
programme.desc: A cyclist takes flight, police find a woman at the wheel of a stolen truck, and officers roll up on a couple smoking meth while their four-year-old is in the car with them.

programme.title: COPS: Hit and Run
programme.desc: The threat of a tasing is enough to slow a fleeing suspect, a heated argument between girlfriends leads to vehicular assault, and a man with weed in his car has no poker face.

programme.title: COPS: Be Careful What You Ask For
programme.desc: An unstable man in a standoff with officers begs to be shot, a drunk woman is accused of beating her spouse, and unwanted guests occupy the garage of an out-of-town homeowner.
programme.sub-title: Be Careful What You Ask For

programme.title: COPS: Cats and Dogs
programme.desc: A trespassing man uses his dog as a shield when police arrive at the scene, a stolen tablet leads to a bloody altercation, and kittens run wild in a Florida neighborhood.

programme.title: COPS: Sittin' in the Dark
programme.desc: A suspect seen fleeing a vehicle refuses to admit he was ever in said vehicle, and police respond to a call that shots were fired.

programme.title: COPS: The Blame Game
programme.desc: An arrested man has a long list of instructions for his "bae," and a driver charged with heroin possession claims he was framed by the passenger in his backseat.

programme.title: Frasier: Rivals
programme.desc: Frasier og Niles' søskenderivaliering spidser tiol, da de hver især tror, den anden prøver på at stjæle hinandens kærester.

programme.title: Frasier: A Tsar is Born
programme.desc: Efter at et familiearvestykke sættes i forbindelse med Romanoff-familien, antager Frasier og Niles pjattet, at de nedstammer fra adelen.

programme.title: Frasier: The Late Dr Crane
programme.desc: En fejlagtig oplysning om, at Frasier er død, motiverer ham til at give sit liv en makeover.

programme.title: Frasier: The Apparent Trap
programme.desc: Da Lilith besøger Seattle til Thanksgiving, konspirerer Frederick på at genforene sine forældre.

programme.title: Frasier: Back Talk
programme.desc: Omtåget af smertestillende medicin kommer Frasier med en overraskende nyhed til Daphne.

programme.title: Frasier: The Fight Before Christmas
programme.desc: Daphne ved, at Niles elsker hende og er tvunget til at konfrontere ham med, hvad hun virkelig føler for ham.

programme.title: Frasier: RDWRER
programme.desc: Efter Frasier og Niles' nytårsplaner falder fra hinanden, tager de en vild køretur med Martin i hans Winnebago.

programme.title: Frasier: They're Playing Our Song
programme.desc: Frasiers forsøg på at skrive en simpel temasang til sit program bliver til en større produktion for ham og Martin.

programme.title: Frasier: Big Crane on Campus
programme.desc: Frasiers 'drømmedate' med en tidligere prom queen bliver til et levende mareridt.

programme.title: Frasier: Out With Dad
programme.desc: Martin lader som om han er homoseksuel for at slippe for at date en kvinde, han ikke finder attraktiv.

programme.title: Frasier: Something About Dr. Mary
programme.desc: Da Roz tager en ferie, overtager Frasiers nye call screener Roz's job, og hansprogram.

programme.title: Frasier: Whine Club
programme.desc: Frasier og Niles åbner for en skidt omgang søskenderivalisering, da de konkurrerer om en prestigefyldt position i deres vinklub.

programme.title: Frasier: Hot Pursuit
programme.desc: Mens Niles slutter sig til Martin på en overvågning, Roz og Frasier flirter med idéen om at blive mere end bare venner.

programme.title: Frasier: Morning Becomes Entertainment
programme.desc: Frasier bliver mindet om sin professionelle værdighed, da han bliver medvært på et tåbeligt morgen-tv-program med sin agent, Bebe.

programme.title: Frasier: To Thine Old Self Be True
programme.desc: Frasiers spirende romance kompliceres af en stripper; Maris forsøger at saboterer Niles' nye forhold.
programme.sub-title: To Thine Old Self Be True

programme.title: Frasier: Dark Side of the Moon
programme.desc: Ankomsten af Daphnes belastende bror, Simon, frigiver en følelsesmæssig flodbølge, der driver hende ind i terapi.

programme.title: Frasier: Something Borrowed Someone Blue (Part 1)
programme.desc: Netop da Daphne beslutter at deklarere sin kærlighed til Niles, smider han en overraskende nyhed.

programme.title: Frasier: Something Borrowed Someone Blue (Part 2)
programme.desc: Umiddelbart før sit bryllup er Daphne's splittet mellem manden, hun elsker, og manden, hun ar lovet at gifte sig med.

programme.title: Frasier: And the Dish Ran Away With the Spoon Part 1
programme.desc: Niles og Daphne flygter fra hendes bryllupsalter, men opdager snart, at den høje pris, de må betale for at indrømme deres sande kærlighed., og den forsmåede gom, Donny, og bitre kone, Mel, vil have hævn.
programme.sub-title: And the Dish Ran Away With the Spoon Part 1

programme.title: Frasier: And the Dish Ran Away With the Spoon Part 2
programme.desc: Mel accepterer skilsmisse fra Niles, men forbyder ham at date Daphne.
programme.sub-title: And the Dish Ran Away With the Spoon Part 2

programme.title: Frasier: The Bad Son
programme.desc: Frasier tager bussen med Roz for første gang, og Frasier bruger Martin til at møde en kvinde på et alderdomshjem. Niles og Daphne genskaber en date.

programme.title: Frasier: The Great Crane Robbery
programme.desc: Frasier er mentor for en millionær, som kopierer alt, hvad han gør.

programme.title: Frasier: Taking Liberties
programme.desc: Stemningen bliver trykket, da Mel udsætter Niles for social ydmygelse, før hun går med til at lade sig skille. Til sidste kan han ikke længere holde manglen på respekt ud, og situationent eksploderer til en fest.

programme.title: Frasier: Legal Tender Love and Care
programme.desc: Donny dropper at lægge sag and mod Frasier og Daphne, fordi han har mødt en anden kvinde, som han vil giftes med. Frasier dater sin advokat, Abbey, men beskylder hende for at tage for meget for hendes professionelle advokatydelser.

programme.title: Frasier: The New Friend
programme.desc: Frasier bedrager Roz ved blive ved med at være venner med hendes utro ekskæreste.

programme.title: Frasier: Mary Christmas
programme.desc: Frasier er tøvende medvært sammen med sin radiorival ved Seattles juleparade.

programme.title: Frasier: Frasiers Edge
programme.desc: Frasier belønnes med prisen Lifetime Achievement Award. Martin, hans far, modtager prisen på sønnens vegne, fordi Frasier har taget fri for at analysere sit eget liv med sin gamle Harvard-mentor, professor Tewsbury.

programme.title: Frasier: Cranes Unplugged
programme.desc: Frasier tager på camping med sin far og sin teenagesøn.

programme.title: Frasier: Motor Skills
programme.desc: Frasier og Niles går i skole igen for at lære om automekanik.

programme.title: Frasier: The Show Must Go On
programme.desc: Frasier og Niles prøver at genopfriske karrieren fra deres ungdoms Shakespeare-skuespiller/idol blot for at finde ud af, at han er et dårligt menneske.

programme.title: Frasier: Sliding Frasier
programme.desc: Frasiers datingskæbne udfolder sig i et par paralleluniverser.

programme.title: Frasier: Hungry Heart
programme.desc: Niles og Daphne beslutter at gå på slankekur. Roz prøver en ny fantastisk parfume, der tiltrækker mænd. Frasier går på en date med Eileen, Kennys kone.

programme.title: Frasier: Hooping Cranes
programme.desc: Efter Niles skyder et umuligt half-court-skud, synes Frasier, at han er umulig at bo sammen med.

programme.title: Frasier: Docu Drama
programme.desc: Roz laver en rumdokumentar med Senator John Glenn. Niles lærer at flyve med drage.

programme.title: Frasier: It Takes Two to Tangle
programme.desc: Frasier og Niles presser Martins rige kæreste til at redde deres konkursramte privatskole.

programme.title: Frasier: Forgotten But Not Gone
programme.desc: Frasier forlader sin vinklub for at være vært på et nyt radiofænomen og bliver vred over at finde ud af, at den forurettede Niles, klubbens arrogante 'korkmaster', har beordret klubbens gamle medlemmer til ikke at deltage i programmet.

programme.title: Frasier: Daphne Returns
programme.desc: Niles og Daphne 'bliver seriøse' omkring deres romance.

programme.title: Frasier: The Wizard of Roz
programme.desc: Daphne forsøger at bevise Niles om sine synske åbenbaringer, og Frasier er egoistiskm da han opdager, at Roz har en affære med hans mentor.

programme.title: Star Trek: Nemesis
programme.desc: Kursen er sat mod en galakse med action og eventyr uden lige, mens kaptajn Jean-Luc Picard (Patrick Stewart) og hans stjerneskibsbesætning kæmper mod en farlig modstander, som har en overraskende forbindelse til Picard!

programme.title: Star Trek I: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: Da et uidentificeret objekt ødelægger de tre mægtige Klingon-krydsere vender kaptajn James T. Kirk (William Shatner) tilbage til det nyligt ombyggede U.S.S. Enterprise(tm) for at overtage kommandoen.

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: Det er 2200-tallet. Føderationens U.S.S. Enterprise er på en træingsopgave, og admiral James T. Kirk (William Shatner) har forsonet sig med, at inspektionen kan blive den sidste rumrejse i hans karriere. Men Khan er tilbage.

programme.title: Star Trek III: Jagten På Spock
programme.desc: Admiral Kirks sejr over Khan og oprettelsen af Genesis-planeten er tomme sejre. Spock er død, og McCoy bliver på uforklarlig vis drevet til vanvid. Så giver et overraskende besøg af Sarek, Spocks far, en opsigtsvækkende åbenbaring..

programme.title: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
programme.desc: Det er det 23. århundrede, og en rumvæsenmagt fordamper havene. For at redde menneskeheden må Kirk og hans besætning rejse tilbage til 1986, hvor de finder en verden fuld af Punk, Pizza og byttebusser, er vildfremmed for dem!

programme.title: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
programme.desc: Besætningen om bord på føderations stjerneskib Enterprise beordres til Nimbus III, den intergalaktiske fredsplanet. De må kun forhandle i en sag om kidnapning for blot at finde ud af, at kidnapperen er i familie med Spock.

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
programme.desc: Efter flere års krig forbereder føderationen og Klingon-imperiet en fredskonference, da et Klingon-skib næsten bliver ødelagt af et tilsyneladende angreb fra Enterprise. De to verdener ruster sig til deres endelige kamp.

programme.title: Star Trek VII: Generations
programme.desc: Picards eneste håb for en fremtid hviler hos Nexus...og en legendarisk kaptajn fra fortiden.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Evelyne Boucher Case
programme.desc: On December 9th 1987, the naked body of the young Evelyne Boucher is found near Avignon. An unprecedented investigation begins making headlines.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Killer Cop (Tavernier Case)
programme.desc: Firefighters in Barbizieux, Charente, are called to a fire in a large house in the village. They arrive to find the lifeless body of the owner, Claude Tavernier, 83, lying in a large pool of blood.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Killer Cop (Tavernier Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Céline Marchand Case
programme.desc: On May 30th 2015 in Sorinières, Yann Machand reports his wife Céline Marchand missing.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Adeline Piet Case
programme.desc: A man walks into a gendarmerie near Saint-Malo to report that his wife has been missing since the previous day. The couple are going through a divorce, but this mother would never have left her seven children alone! What has happened to Adeline Piet?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Corpse In The Cemetery: The Frederic Butanowicz Case
programme.desc: On November 9, 2011, the body of a man was found near the Courcelles-le-Comte cemetery (Pas-de-Calais).
programme.sub-title: A Corpse In The Cemetery: The Frederic Butanowicz Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Deathly Fatal Passion At the Hotel (Villermet case)
programme.desc: The body of Nathalie Villermet, 46, manager of a small hotel and -restaurant, is found by a walker in the woods outside Paris, hidden under branches.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Deathly Fatal Passion At the Hotel (Villermet case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Drost Notthoff Case
programme.desc: On September 11th 2011, in Èze, near Monaco, the owner of a luxury villa discovers the lifeless hanging body of his tenant, a rich German businessman.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Shadow of A Serial Killer: The Sophie Le Tan Case
programme.desc: On September 7, 2018, in Strasbourg, Sophie Le Tan is about to celebrate her 20th birthday with her family.
programme.sub-title: The Shadow of A Serial Killer: The Sophie Le Tan Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: In Search of SK1 - Akira Ojima Case
programme.desc: On October 13th 1996, the body of young Angélique Dumetz, 18 years old, is recovered down a ditch in Oise forest. An important clue is found on the crime scene.
programme.sub-title: In Search of SK1 - Akira Ojima Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
programme.desc: On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows?
programme.sub-title: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)
programme.desc: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a road accident while on honeymoon. His wife Aurore is unharmed by the accident.
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot At Point-Blank: The Aurelie Barbot Affair
programme.desc: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.
programme.sub-title: Shot At Point-Blank: The Aurelie Barbot Affair

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)
programme.desc: On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed.
programme.sub-title: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Strange Hanging - Chantal Ternik Case
programme.desc: On April 3th 2003, Chantal Ternik, a 48 year old housewife, is discovered hanged in her house of Sanary-sur-Mer, in Var.
programme.sub-title: A Strange Hanging - Chantal Ternik Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Jean-Raymond Blatti Case
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written \"DIRTY RAPIST\".

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 512
programme.desc: Nina arbejder som show-pige, og det påvirker derfor hendes arbejde meget, når hun skal fokusere på et rutsjende implantat og en grim kavalergang.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 309
programme.desc: Vi møder Ditte, der har brugt 120.000 kr. på at få lavet sine bryster større, og som i dag står tilbage med kæmpestore, men asymmetriske bryster.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 502
programme.desc: Lenette har tabt sig 55 kilo og føler, at hun har for meget løs hud på mave, bryster og lår. Hun finder derfor en kirurg, foretager alle tre operationer, men det går ikke som planlagt.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 614
programme.desc: 24-årige Bettina har hele livet været ked af sin næse, der i folkeskolen har givet anledning til øgenavne som Pelikanen og H.C. Andersen.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 603
programme.desc: For tre år siden valgte Sarah at få foretaget en brystforstørrende operation i Polen, men efter indgrebet syntes hun, brysterne lignede to kaffeposer med implantater.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 608
programme.desc: I 2011 vælger Sabina at få lavet en brystforstørrende operation. Men allerede få dage efter indgrebet opdager hun, at brysterne hænger.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt
programme.desc: Vi møder Connie, der ønskede sig naturlige bryster, men blev rådgivet af sin kirurg til at vælge de største implantater. Nu føler hun, at hun har fået lavet så store bryster, at folk tænker: ”..der kommer brysterne med Connie”

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 612
programme.desc: Efter et større vægttab får 25-årige Michele lavet en maveskindsoperation, men resultatet skuffer slemt, og Michele har fået store problemer med sin livskvalitet.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 203
programme.desc: Mød Pia, der efter en brystforstørrende operation fik stafylokokker og måtte gå 6 måneder med kun ét implantat hun først fik ud, da hun fik blodforgiftning.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 610
programme.desc: Sportsglade Jeanette blev for 12 år siden inspireret af en trend i fitnesscenteret, hvor veninderne fik opereret deres bryster større. Modsat veninderne bliver hun ikke glad for sine nye store bryster.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 403
programme.desc: Vi møder Charlotte, der har svært ved at få et forhold til en mand, fordi hun skammer sig over sine silikonebryster, og Katja, som kæmper med gamle tråde fra tidligere operationer i brysterne.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 507
programme.desc: For 10 år siden får Michelle fjernet en godartet cyste bag højre øje. Operationen medfører, at øjenlåget hænger løst nedover øjet.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt
programme.desc: Mød Louise, der brugte familiens penge på en brystoperation, der endte med at blive en traumatisk oplevelse for hende.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 509
programme.desc: Philip fik som 16-årig brækket næsen i en slåskamp og har siden forsøgt at få den pæn gennem en række operationer i udlandet. Alle operationerne er mislykkedes.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 101
programme.desc: I Mit plastikmareridt møder vi i aftenens program fire ofre for plastiskkirurgiske fejloperationer. Mille, der jagter drømmen om det perfekte, Joan, der føler, at hun har mistet sin femininitet.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 302
programme.desc: Fejlslagne plastikoperationer har givet fire kvinder ar på både krop og sjæl. Vi møder Isabella, en 18-årig pige, hvis brystforstørrelse var en total katastrofe.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 306
programme.desc: Vi møder bl.a. Jeanette, der føler sig som en forsøgskanin efter en række mislykkede operationer og Shahin, som lever i et smertehelvede efter en ansigtsløftning, hun blev overtalt til på en klinik i Litauen.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 902
programme.desc: Efter en brystoperation har Samantha tunge, smertende bryster og et forhold, der skranter. Allan har efterfølgende udtrykt uenighed i Samanthas udlægning af, hvorfor forholdet stoppede.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 103
programme.desc: Ivana, der ikke bare endte med at bruge en million kroner i USA, men hvor lægerne tog en fatal beslutning under hendes narkose, Lotte, der har forsøgt at skjule sit ødelagte maveskind bag tatoveringer.

programme.title: Mit plastikmareridt: Episode 310
programme.desc: Vi møder bodybuilderen Ulla, der ønskede sig bryster, som skulle få hende til at se kvindelig ud, men som nu har fået så store implantater, at hun har svært ved at træne.
